interface.name: kidul_settings_tray_v1
interface.description: This interface is implemented by the KidulWM compositor and allows a GTK4/any client to bind a settings tray surface that floats above the layout chrome. It is intentionally minimal for now; the client sends the binding request and the compositor allocates a layer-shell surface internally.

request.name: get_tray
request.description: Returns a kidul_settings_tray_surface_v1 object that the client can use to configure the tray window.

interface.name: kidul_settings_tray_surface_v1
interface.description: Single tray surface. Width/height hints are in surface-local logical pixels; the compositor may clamp them to the output size.
